messages:
mira: Heads-up — CloudMall (marketplace partner) just proposed a Black Friday promo window: 72h spike, expected listing traffic x5 in US-W and EU-W. They want a capacity commit + runbook. Who can run a quick GPU-hours + cost delta?
aj: I can do a rough projection in an hour. Do we know model mix? FP16 13B vs 70B changes everything.
mira: Partner will use our default inference bundle (quantized 13B-ish) for chat and embeddings. They also may opt into a reranking job that runs asynchronously.
jonathan: Current baseline: us-west GPUs avg util 68% over last 7d, spare pool ~120 A100-hr/day after normal autoscale. eu-west spare ~80 A100-hr/day.
sasha: Is the spike mostly synchronous (live traffic) or async (batch rerank)? CloudMall said peak hours will be synchronous 18:00-00:00 PT, with background rerank jobs overnight.
aj: OK assumptions: synchronous 5x for 8 hours/day, 3x for remaining 16 hours, plus rerank ~200k jobs/day (each ~0.02 GPU-hr). I'll sketch numbers.
aj (later): Quick CSV forecast snippet:```region,baseline_gpu_hrs_per_day,peak_multiplier,extra_gpu_hrs_per_day_usg
us-west,1200,avg 2.8,1680
eu-west,900,avg 2.2,1080
Total extra per day (estimated): 660 GPU-hrs
For 3 days: ~1980 GPU-hrs```
mira: That looks lower than I expected — is that accounting for KV cache benefits on repeated prompts?
aj: Yes roughly. Repeated prompts and prefix caching reduce token compute by ~20% during sustained peak. I tried to bake that in.
jonathan: Important constraint: our us-west reserved pool is mostly committed during 18:00-22:00 right now. To guarantee latency SLOs we need either pre-warm burst instances or lean on eu-west routing. Pre-warm estimate: ~600 extra GPU-hrs/day (warmed nodes cost ~10% of running cost during idle).
infra-bot: ALERT: scheduled-maintenance window in us-west on 1799941800 may reduce available A100s by 8% if not postponed.
sasha: We should ask infra to postpone maintenance or confirm node counts. @aj can you model two scenarios: (A) pre-purchase burst (Dedicated reserved hours) in us-west, (B) cross-region spill to eu-west plus routing latency impact?
aj: Yes. Scenario A: pre-buy 2,000 A100-hrs (3 days) as committed burst. Premium ~ +40% on spot pricing but guarantees capacity. Cost delta rough: +$28k. Scenario B: spill 40% traffic to eu-west; eu-west will need ~800 extra GPU-hrs/day, latency increase ~+70-120ms p50 for EU->US users but fine for embeddings. Cost delta ~+$16k but potential user latency regressions for US traffic.
liz: From marketplace/reseller terms: CloudMall requires <200ms p95 for chat or we lose the promo. If spill pushes p95 >200ms for US customers, they'd push back.
jonathan: With routing and edge caching we might keep p95 ~190ms for most sessions but worst-case pockets could hit 220ms. Not ideal.
sasha: Is there a hybrid? Part commit in us-west to cover top 30% of traffic + spill rest. That reduces pre-purchase to ~1200 A100-hrs over 3 days. Cost delta ~+$18.5k and keeps p95 ~<200ms for most.
mira: That seems reasonable. Also need an ops runbook: autoscale thresholds, fallback model variant (smaller 6B quantized) if latency breaches, and a clear billing addendum for the partner.
aj: Draft runbook items: 1) Pre-warm 150 nodes in us-west 12h before window; 2) Set canary traffic -> 6B fallback at 5% error spike; 3) Route overflow to eu-west when queue length > 60s; 4) Enable aggressive KV cache TTL of 2h for partner route.
infra-bot: NOTE: canary deploy scheduled by infra at 1799944200 if approved.
liz: I'll draft the pricing addendum: hybrid option (partial commit + spill) at $18.5k one-time for the 3-day window, plus overage at $X/hr. Send draft to CloudMall by EOD.
mira: Action items: @aj finalize numbers (A/B/Hybrid) by +2h, @jonathan confirm maintenance postpone with infra, @liz draft addendum and send. If all good, we approve pre-warm.
jonathan: I'll ping infra leads now — linking ops ticket #OPS-4389.
sasha: Also add monitoring dashboard: per-route token/sec, queue-length, p95 latency per region, and automatic alert to #incidents at >180ms p95.
mira: Great. If we get partner commitment, we should run a smoke test on staging with 2x traffic simulation 24h before.
aj: Will simulate and include graphs in my numbers.
liz: ack, will prepare contract language.
infra-bot: TASK CREATED: OPS-4389 (postpone maintenance) assigned to eng-infra.
mira: Thanks team :thumbsup: Let’s regroup after aj's numbers.
